scope.summary: Implement the parametric avatar writer per Section 13.24 (BodyKit<->Cloth contract): BodyKit publishes tailor_avatars rows with source_kind='parametric' and morph_params_json carrying the full channel state, plus the 25-measurement extraction from the generated body mesh, closing the coverage-map hole where Cloth cannot see BodyKit bodies (REQ-043 stable-id channel state as the avatar payload).
acceptance_criteria: Saving or promoting a BodyKit body writes a tailor_avatars row with source_kind='parametric' and morph_params_json = complete channel state keyed by stable snake_case channel ids, via the event-before-row CTE (TAILOR_BODY_* event precedes the row).

A 25-measurement set (bust/underbust/waist/hip circumference, shoulder width, inseam, arm/torso/leg lengths, hand/foot scale, neck, thigh, calf, penis length where module enabled, etc.) is extracted from the generated mesh via landmark curves and stored in mm authority (cm on the LLM surface).
A channel change on the source body updates the derived avatar row and bumps its version; Cloth garment fitting reads the new measurements without any manual re-import step.
EventLedger replay reconstructs an identical tailor_avatars row (payload hash equal) for a body authored, edited, and re-saved.
Deleting/retiring a body soft-retires its avatar row without breaking garments that reference it (typed dangling-ref warning, not corruption).
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the writer, BodyKit bodies are invisible to the entire Cloth engine — no drape, no fitting, no garment work against parametric bodies — and the documented coverage-map hole ships into V1.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit, Cloth, and contact integration

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Reconcile the BodyKit cloth bridge with shared topology/material/collider snapshots, the per-tier interaction matrix, portal-aware cavity metadata, final f64 authority, and promotion-safe receipts without expanding BodyKit anatomy authoring in this slice.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
